g.text: Existing JOINT K4 small-pool priority policies, with two actual assisted endpoints connected
Exact subset probabilities; no simulated or newly fused teams. Average prefixes 3 to N−1 within pool, then within image.
15 eligible pools / 14 images, N ≤ 9. Panels C–D require all members to have positive records from one time source; this is a different, explicit support.
The two new Q values expand support; all 1,046 originally scoreable endpoint values remain unchanged. Full-N endpoint scores are identical across policies.
